transition: s_next = action % num_states; all rewards zero; no termination; Q*=V*=0
noise_convention: At updates 1,D+1,2D+1,... copy pre-update target_Q+current_epsilon and V, construct the full filter once, and reuse it for exactly D updates. Receiver uses current target_Q+current_epsilon. Noise lag is 0,1,...,D-1 in every complete block. No alternative timing is supported.
metric: mean_s max_a mean_i clean Q_i(s,a); sample SD across 20 seeds; filtering bias and learned V measured separately
